Is a value a registered scenario id? (vectorised predicate)

Source: R/urps_scenarios.R
is_urps_scenario.Rd

A non-erroring, vectorised membership test against the registry – the building block for a fail-loud guard or a filter.

Usage

is_urps_scenario(x)

Arguments

x

A character vector of candidate ids.

Value

A logical vector the same length as x (NA in, FALSE out).

See also

validate_urps_scenarios(), urps_scenario_ids()

Other URPS scenarios: URPS_SCENARIO_REGISTRY_VERSION, urps_scenario(), urps_scenario_ids(), urps_scenarios(), validate_urps_scenarios()

Examples

is_urps_scenario(c("baseline", "typo", NA)) # TRUE FALSE FALSE
#> [1]  TRUE FALSE FALSE
